# proxmox_guest_move_disk (Resource)

Moves a QEMU disk through `POST /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/move_disk` and waits for the worker.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_guest_move_disk" "m" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  vmid     = 300
  disk     = "scsi0"
  storage  = "target"
  delete   = true
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `storage` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Optional

- `bwlimit` (Number)
- `delete` (Boolean)
- `digest` (String)
- `format` (String)
- `target_digest` (String)
- `target_disk` (String)
- `target_vmid` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upid` (String)
